description: Reads what the signed-in user keeps on the Barrio Grid map, in three lists: Properties (sites they own or control), Prospects (sites they are pursuing) and Saved places (points they bookmarked on the map or asked an assistant to save). Each list holds projects: sites, tracts, boundaries and routes imported from KMZ, KML or GeoJSON (Google Earth, Land id and similar exports), dropped on the map, or synced from the user's own systems. With no project, lists everything grouped by list (pass list to narrow). With a project name or id, returns each feature's name, type, a representative point (lat/lng), acreage for shapes, folder and note. With screen: true, runs site_screen on up to 25 features and ranks them by score with the top strengths and risks. Use when the user refers to their own sites ('my properties', 'my prospects', 'the places I saved', 'my Edna tract'), or asks to compare, rank or screen their own sites; follow up on any single site with the location tools. Private to the account; in a team workspace it also includes teammates' shared Properties and Prospects, each tagged added_by. Pro reads features and screens; free accounts see project names and counts.

list.description: Only this list. Omit for all three.

project.description: Project name (or part of it) or id. Omit to list projects. 'Saved places' reads the saved places.

screen.description: Screen and rank up to 25 sites in the project with site_screen. Default false.

use.description: With screen: intended use, shifts the weights. Default data_center.
